def transform(grid):
    """Fill between successive 5 markers in each row with color 3."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg]
        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
PY
